mavzu: Unit 5: Time management. Lesson 2.B. Priority organiser

savollar.savol: "priority" so'zi ta'rifini tanlang.
variantlar: Boshqa ishlardan oldin bajarilishi shart bo'lgan juda muhim narsa

savollar.savol: "Save time" iborasi qanday ma'noni bildiradi?
"Waste time" iborasi nimani anglatadi?
"Free/spare time" tushunchasining ma'nosini tanlang.
"On time" iborasi qachon ishlatiladi?
"Run out of time" iborasi ma'nosi qanday?
"Kill time / pass the time" iborasi qanday holatda ishlatiladi?
"It's about time" iborasi qanday vaziyatda ishlatiladi?
variantlar: Biror narsa ancha kechikib, allaqachon bo'lishi kerak bo'lganda
Biror narsa juda erta sodir bo'lganda

savollar.savol: "Have a hard/rough time" iborasi nimani bildiradi?
"Just in time" iborasi ma'nosini tanlang.
"Students ______ behave well when they're in class." gapini to'g'ri modal fe'l bilan to'ldiring.
"If you drive a car, you ______ stop at marked crossings." gapini to'ldiring.
"I think waiters _____ try to be pleasant with customers." gapiga mos modal fe'lni tanlang.
"Some workers _____ wear helmets because their jobs are considered to be dangerous." gapini to'ldiring.
"If you feel sick, you _____ stay at home. It's better for you." gapini to'ldiring.
"I ______ do my homework. My teacher always checks if we have done the exercises." gapiga mos modalni tanlang.
"We _______ organise our portfolio. At the end of the term it will be marked." gapini to'ldiring.
"I _______ study hard. I want to pass the exam." gapini to'ldiring.
"In Uzbekistan, children _______ go to vocational colleges or academic lyceums after finishing school." gapini to'ldiring.
"You _______ phone your parents every day, when you are abroad." gapini to'ldiring.
"You ________ accept things from strangers!" gapiga mos modal fe'lni tanlang (xavfni hisobga olib).
"You _______ offend your friend or colleague." gapini to'g'ri to'ldiring.
"Children _______ think about their future profession seriously." gapiga mos modalni tanlang (bolalar hali yosh ekanini hisobga olib).
"Children ________ play computer games all day." gapini to'ldiring.
"We ________ get up very early at the weekends." gapiga mos modalni tanlang (majburiyat yo'qligini hisobga olib).
Matnga ko'ra, nonushtani ertalab emas, balki kechqurun tayyorlab qo'yish nima uchun tavsiya etiladi?
variantlar: Chunki bu ertalabki vaqtni tejashga yordam beradi

savollar.savol: Matn bo'yicha, ish yoki maktabga lunch/snackni oldindan kechqurun tayyorlab qo'yishning afzalligi nimada?
variantlar: Faqat pul tejaydi, boshqa foydasi yo'q
Sog'lomroq, mazaliroq va arzonroq tanlov qilish imkonini beradi

savollar.savol: Kalendar (haftalik jadval) tuzish bosqichlarida ish vaqti, oila mas'uliyati va dars vaqtlari to'ldirilgandan so'ng, matnga ko'ra keyingi qadam qanday bo'lishi kerak?
variantlar: Qolgan bo'sh joylarni 'bo'sh vaqt' deb belgilash

savollar.savol: "I'd like to take violin lessons, but I don't have enough time" gapi quyidagi qaysi "time" bilan bog'liq kollokatsiyaga misol bo'la oladi?
"I must study hard. I want to pass the exam" va "I have to do my homework. My teacher always checks" gaplarini solishtirib, 'must' va 'have to' o'rtasidagi farqni aniqlang.
variantlar: Ikkalasi ham faqat tashqi qoidani bildiradi
Ular orasida hech qanday farq yo'q
'Must' shaxsning o'z ichki qarori/istagini, 'have to' esa tashqaridan qo'yilgan talabni bildiradi
